_comment: Adds the World Championship to the season timeline. It previously ended at "Qualified for the FIRST World Championship", so the timeline never recorded that the team actually went.

items.summary: 5th Place Alliance Partner and Think Award 1st Place.
Winning Alliance Captain, Inspire Award 2nd Place, and Qualified for the Regional Championship.
Winning Alliance Partner alongside Team 10949 M.O.B., Innovate Award 1st Place, and Qualified for the FIRST World Championship in Houston, Texas.
Our first trip to Worlds, competing in the Ross Division in Houston, Texas.

#10 highest score in the world and #1 OPR in New York. At the FIRST World Championship we were the 1st pick of a 5th-place divisional alliance, closing the season ranked #75 EPA and #99 OPR worldwide.
